title: When I read the Bible, it feels like I am there witnessing the moment…
paragraphs: When I read the Bible, it feels like I am there witnessing the moment…
The hillside is quiet… almost unbearably still.
Abraham had lifted the knife only moments before. The weight of obedience hung in the air like the silence before a storm. No one moved. No one breathed.
Then something shifts in the brush.
A ram… caught in the thicket.
Provision appears at the last moment.
Standing there as a witness, I realize how often God’s provision arrives the same way in our lives—not when we first hope for it, but precisely when we most need it.
The thicket becomes more than tangled branches… it becomes a reminder.

God sees the mountain before we climb it.
God prepares the ram before we know we’ll need one.
And sometimes the miracle is already there—waiting—just beyond what we can see.
What provision might already be waiting in the thicket of my own circumstances?
